ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions across both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is localized to the entire trailing edge margin, both distal tips, and a central wedge extending from the notch to the peduncle. A single, discrete black circular spot is located at [X:285, Y:660] relative coordinates on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees and a depth of approximately 12% of the total vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous fine-scale serration with low-amplitude (2-4 pixel) peaks across the trailing edge. Frequency is higher on the outer third of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a consistent convex curve from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast clusters at both distal tips. Left tip shows small white nodes. Right tip features a dense, textured cluster of white and pinkish nodes corresponding to biological colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, short, dark linear pixel disruption is visible on the inner-lower quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; isolated circular pigmentation mark on the mid-left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The barnacle cluster on the right tip exhibits a unique pinkish/reddish pixel distribution that is not present elsewhere on the fluke.
